name: Unitree R1-A-D
summary: A wheeled dual-arm upper body on a lifting column (about 0.68 m retracted) with 5- or 7-axis arms carrying 2 to 4 kg each and a choice of gripper or three- or five-finger hands, for light handling at benches and shelves.

germany.statusNote: Not orderable yet. Terra Robotics (DE) lists all R1-A-D versions with net EUR prices, but every version is marked 'Auf Anfrage' (on request) and none can be put in the cart. quadruped.de shows 'price on request, available from 15.02.2027', and Unitree's own store marks all R1-A versions unavailable.

priceEur.note: Terra Robotics, R1-A5-D Smart A (Dex1-1 gripper), excl. VAT. R1-A7-D Smart: EUR 12,738.25 to 25,262.12 net; R1-A5-D Smart: 12,061.28 to 24,585.16; R1-A5-D Flagship: 13,753.70 to 26,277.57. Price depends on the hand option. All versions shown as on request.

sellers.name: Terra Robotics
sellers.note: R1-A7-D Smart, 8 hand versions A to H from EUR 12,738.25 to 25,262.12 excl. VAT; button reads 'Auf Anfrage', no version can be put in the cart. Separate pages for R1-A5-D Smart and R1-A5-D Flagship.

sellers.name: QUADRUPED Robotics (quadruped.de)
sellers.note: One page for R1-A5, R1-A7, R1-A5-D and R1-A7-D in Smart and Flagship versions; 'Preis auf Anfrage', 'Verfügbar ab: 15.02.2027'. Also lists R1-A-D spare parts such as the chassis battery (EUR 1,050 net).

specs.label: Height
specs.conditions: raised (Unitree); Terra Robotics states 1.323 m extended

specs.label: Total DOF
specs.conditions: R1-A7-D with gripper; R1-A5-D 18. Terra lists up to 34 for R1-A7-D with Dex3-1 three-finger hands.

specs.label: Max payload per arm
specs.conditions: stated as 2 to 4 kg; varies strongly with arm extension posture

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: Head: 8-core CPU + 10 TOPS; body: 8-core CPU; optional module such as Orin 40-100 TOPS
specs.conditions: Terra Smart versions include a 40 TOPS dock, Flagship versions a 100 TOPS dock

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Chassis LiDAR, binocular camera (146 x 124 deg FOV), optional wrist camera, 4-mic array, dual speakers
specs.conditions: Terra: L2 LiDAR on Smart, DJI MID360 LiDAR on Flagship

specs.label: End effectors
specs.value: Two-finger gripper, three-finger or five-finger dexterous hand
specs.conditions: chosen per order; Terra lists 8 versions (Dex1-1 gripper, Dex3-1, Revo 2, Linker Hand O6, tendon hand)

specs.label: Development
specs.value: Open interfaces for underlying system, arms, audio, lighting and vision; OTA updates

notes: Arm payload is a maximum of 2 to 4 kg that drops with arm extension; no rated value published.
The end effector is chosen per order: the cheapest Terra version has a two-finger gripper, others have three- or five-finger hands.
About 1.5 h on battery; external power is also supported.
Unitree warns users to keep a safe distance from the arms; no safety certification or IP rating is published.
No stair, rough-ground or outdoor claim is published for the wheeled base.
